schema: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_material_request_per_operator ON material_reservations(operator_id) WHERE status IN('queued','active')
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_session_per_actor ON sessions(world_id,actor_id) WHERE revoked=0

CREATE TABLE entities(
  entity_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, world_id TEXT NOT NULL, owner_actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  recipe_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recipes(id), definition_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  definition_version INTEGER NOT NULL, rules_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  x REAL NOT NULL CHECK(x BETWEEN 0 AND 32), y REAL NOT NULL CHECK(y BETWEEN 0 AND 24),
  embodied_wood INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(embodied_wood IN(3,6)), UNIQUE(world_id,x,y),
  FOREIGN KEY(world_id,owner_actor_id) REFERENCES residents(world_id,actor_id))

CREATE TABLE entity_note_adoption(
  singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), capability TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(capability='entity-notes-v1'),
  version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version=1), entity_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES entities(entity_id),
  instance_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES world_instance(instance_id), state_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  event_seq INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES events(seq))

CREATE TABLE entity_notes(
  note_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, world_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES worlds(id),
  entity_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES entities(entity_id), author_actor_id TEXT NOT NULL, operator_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  command_id TEXT NOT NULL, text TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(text) BETWEEN 1 AND 160),
  reply_to_note_id TEXT REFERENCES entity_notes(note_id), state_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  event_seq INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES events(seq) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
  shared_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL, x REAL NOT NULL, y REAL NOT NULL, inventory_wood INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(inventory_wood BETWEEN 0 AND 12),
  UNIQUE(world_id,author_actor_id,command_id), FOREIGN KEY(world_id,author_actor_id) REFERENCES residents(world_id,actor_id))

CREATE TABLE events(
  seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, world_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES worlds(id),
  state_version INTEGER NOT NULL, event_json TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(world_id,state_version))

CREATE TABLE material_production(
  production_period INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(production_period>0), service_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 3), event_seq INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES events(seq))

CREATE TABLE material_reservations(
  queue_sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, reservation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  world_id TEXT NOT NULL, actor_id TEXT NOT NULL, operator_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_command_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN('queued','active','completed','cancelled','expired')),
  requested_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(requested_at_ms>=0), granted_at_ms INTEGER, expires_at_ms INTEGER,
  remaining INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(remaining BETWEEN 0 AND 3),
  UNIQUE(world_id,actor_id,request_command_id), FOREIGN KEY(world_id,actor_id) REFERENCES residents(world_id,actor_id),
  CHECK((granted_at_ms IS NULL AND expires_at_ms IS NULL) OR expires_at_ms=granted_at_ms+60000),
  CHECK(status!='active' OR (granted_at_ms IS NOT NULL AND remaining>0)),
  CHECK(status!='completed' OR remaining=0))

CREATE TABLE "material_source"(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), active INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(active IN(0,1)),
  service_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(service_ms)='integer' AND service_ms>=0), enabled_at_ms INTEGER, next_production_ms INTEGER,
  production_period INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(production_period)='integer' AND production_period>=0),
  generated_wood INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(generated_wood)='integer' AND generated_wood>=0),
  stock_wood INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(stock_wood)='integer' AND stock_wood BETWEEN 0 AND 6),
  CHECK(stock_wood<=generated_wood), CHECK((active=0 AND enabled_at_ms IS NULL AND next_production_ms IS NULL) OR
    (active=1 AND typeof(enabled_at_ms)='integer' AND enabled_at_ms>=0 AND typeof(next_production_ms)='integer'
      AND next_production_ms=enabled_at_ms+(production_period+1)*10000)))

CREATE TABLE material_source_policy(
  singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), policy_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(policy_id='continuous-service-time-v1'),
  policy_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(policy_version=1), instance_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES world_instance(instance_id),
  adopted_service_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(adopted_service_ms>=0), state_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(state_version>0),
  event_seq INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES events(seq), generated_at_adoption INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generated_at_adoption BETWEEN 0 AND 12),
  production_period_at_adoption INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(production_period_at_adoption>=0))

CREATE TABLE receipts(
  world_id TEXT NOT NULL, actor_id TEXT NOT NULL, command_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  request_hash TEXT NOT NULL, status_code INTEGER NOT NULL, result_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(world_id,actor_id,command_id), FOREIGN KEY(world_id,actor_id) REFERENCES residents(world_id,actor_id))

CREATE TABLE recipes(
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, definition_id TEXT NOT NULL, definition_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  rules_version TEXT NOT NULL, wood_cost INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(wood_cost>0))

CREATE TABLE residents(
  world_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES worlds(id), actor_id TEXT NOT NULL, operator_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  x REAL NOT NULL CHECK(x BETWEEN 0 AND 32), y REAL NOT NULL CHECK(y BETWEEN 0 AND 24),
  wood INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(wood BETWEEN 0 AND 12), last_walk_ms INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, walk_credit REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.6, PRIMARY KEY(world_id,actor_id))

CREATE TABLE resource_ledger(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, world_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES worlds(id), event_seq INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES events(seq),
  command_id TEXT, actor_id TEXT, source_account TEXT NOT NULL, destination_account TEXT NOT NULL,
  quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 12))

CREATE TABLE resource_nodes(
  world_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES worlds(id), node_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind='tree'),
  x REAL NOT NULL CHECK(x BETWEEN 0 AND 32), y REAL NOT NULL CHECK(y BETWEEN 0 AND 24),
  initial_wood INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(initial_wood=3),
  remaining_wood INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(remaining_wood)='integer' AND remaining_wood BETWEEN 0 AND initial_wood),
  PRIMARY KEY(world_id,node_id), UNIQUE(world_id,x,y))

CREATE TABLE sessions(
  session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, world_id TEXT NOT NULL, actor_id TEXT NOT NULL, token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  expires_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, revoked INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revoked IN(0,1)),
  FOREIGN KEY(world_id,actor_id) REFERENCES residents(world_id,actor_id))

CREATE TABLE visits(
  world_id TEXT NOT NULL, actor_id TEXT NOT NULL, command_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  activity_id TEXT NOT NULL, state_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  visited_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
  x REAL NOT NULL CHECK(x BETWEEN 0 AND 32), y REAL NOT NULL CHECK(y BETWEEN 0 AND 24),
  PRIMARY KEY(world_id,actor_id,command_id), UNIQUE(world_id,state_version),
  FOREIGN KEY(world_id,actor_id) REFERENCES residents(world_id,actor_id),
  FOREIGN KEY(world_id,state_version) REFERENCES events(world_id,state_version) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
  FOREIGN KEY(world_id,actor_id,command_id) REFERENCES receipts(world_id,actor_id,command_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE world_instance(
  singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),
  instance_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  binding_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(binding_version=1)
)

CREATE TABLE "worlds"(
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id='foundation-01'), scenario_id TEXT NOT NULL, rules_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  state_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(state_version)='integer' AND state_version>=0),
  issued_wood INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(issued_wood)='integer' AND issued_wood>=12),
  depot_wood INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(depot_wood=0), CHECK(scenario_id='wilderness-material-access-v1' AND rules_version='r10'))
